description: WHEN: validate_best_practices returned violations and you want concrete X++ fix suggestions. Returns each BP violation with its built-in fix suggestion AND (when Ollama is available) an AI-generated X++ code patch using the source from the knowledge base. Triggers: 'fix best practice', 'corriger les violations', 'generate fix', 'patch BP'. Set generatePatches=true to call Ollama (ALMXPP_SUMMARIZE_MODEL) for code patches -- requires Ollama running at OLLAMA_HOST. Falls back to built-in fix suggestions if unavailable.

generatePatches.description: Generate X++ code patches via Ollama (requires OLLAMA_HOST). Default false.

objectName.description: Object or method to fix, e.g. 'SalesLine' or 'SalesLine.insert'.

name: fix_best_practice_violations
